sub_sector.value: global freight forwarding; customs brokerage; supply chain logistics

logistics_role.detail: Arranges air and ocean freight, customs and distribution for customers' cargo using third-party carriers.

asset_intensity.detail: Service-based; does not own the aircraft, ships or trucks it uses.
